place_fields.summary: Granite chariot shrine dedicated to Garuda within the Vittala Temple complex, known for its Vijayanagara architecture and detailed stone carvings.

planning_attributes.description: The Stone Chariot is a granite shrine dedicated to Garuda within Hampi's Vittala Temple complex and is one of the complex's best-known monuments.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The shrine is dedicated to Garuda, the eagle mount of Vishnu, and forms part of the Vijayanagara-era Vittala Temple complex.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Hampi is accessible by road and via Hospet Railway Station; local auto-rickshaws and bicycles are used within Hampi.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Carry water and sun protection when visiting Hampi.
planning_attributes.notes: Photography is listed as a recommended activity at the monument.

place_fields.summary: A massive historic watchtower associated with Hampi's Royal Centre, built into the northwest corner of an enclosure and apparently used to watch approaches to the Royal Centre.

planning_attributes.description: The structure is built into and upon the walls forming the northwest corner of an enclosure in Hampi's Royal Centre.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The tower apparently functioned as a watchtower overlooking approaches to the Royal Centre and may have been a later addition to the enclosure walls.
planning_attributes.notes: The upper domed chambers are reached by a staircase at the south end of the east wall; the ground-level chamber is no longer accessible according to the Hampi virtual tourism portal.

place_fields.summary: A long Vijayanagara-period building of eleven large domed chambers that housed royal elephants and combines Hindu and Indo-Islamic architectural features.

planning_attributes.description: The Elephant Stables are an imposing row of domed chambers that once housed the royal elephants of the Vijayanagara Empire.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The stables date to the Vijayanagara period and were used to house royal elephants; the building has eleven large domed chambers with arched connections.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The stables are accessed via the Zenana Enclosure.
planning_attributes.notes: The Incredible India tourism portal lists opening hours of 09:00 AM to 05:00 PM.
